verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports resuming previous conversations in the CLI and switching between local, remote, and cloud agents "without losing focus," which implies some ability to pick up an in-progress task across contexts, and ACP compatibility lets it interoperate with other agent surfaces. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated editor (IDE) takeover UI or a browser-based live handoff mid-task, so cross-surface takeover is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit editor/IDE takeover UI, explicit browser session takeover mechanics, and independent hands-on confirmation of mid-task redirection across surfaces.
